21:
Baba?

Before anything else, I need to say this properly.

I’m really sorry for how I acted earlier :( I know I came off rude and mean, and you didn’t deserve that from me. I let my emotions speak before my understanding did, and I regret that.

When I woke up and saw your message saying you were going out, I was already feeling upset and vulnerable. Instead of asking calmly or telling you how I felt, I assumed things and let that frustration build up inside me. I didn’t say good morning, I didn’t tell you I was awake the whole time, and when we talked, I let that bottled-up feeling come out in my tone. That’s on me.

When I fired back about you not saying anything after “I’m going out,” I wasn’t trying to communicate — I was reacting. I spoke from hurt instead of care, and I understand why that escalated things. I can see now how it made you feel like I was blaming you, when I should’ve just been honest about what was going on in my head.

I want you to know that I wasn’t trying to pick a fight or make you feel bad. I was upset, yes, but that doesn’t excuse being sharp or dismissive with you. You deserve patience, gentleness, and clarity from me — especially when things are already sensitive.

I’m sorry for not saying good morning. I’m sorry for not telling you I was awake. And I’m sorry for letting my tone hurt you when we finally talked. I should’ve handled that moment with more care, because you matter to me.

I’m still learning how to communicate better when my emotions are loud, but please know that my heart was never against you. I care about you deeply, and I hate knowing that my words or tone made you feel otherwise.

Thank you for still talking to me, for listening, and for trying to understand me even when things got messy. I promise to do better — to speak softer, to ask instead of assume, and to remember that we’re on the same side. 

And also I want to speak gently to your heart, because I know it’s been heavy. I know there are moments when you look at us and wonder if you’re enough, or if you’re failing me in some way. I need you to hear this clearly, without doubt or hesitation:

You are not failing me. Not even close baby okay? 

I don’t love you for what you can give me, or for how much effort you manage to show, or for how perfectly you express your love. I don’t love you for consistency, productivity, reassurance, or sacrifice. I love you for who you are — the person you are when you laugh, when you’re quiet, when you’re unsure, when you’re tired, when you’re simply being yourself. That version of you is the one I chose, and the one I continue to choose every day.

If there are times when it feels like I’m giving more, please don’t see that as a burden you need to carry. I’m not keeping score. I’m not waiting for you to repay me or catch up. I give because loving you comes naturally to me. It’s not a chore, and it’s not something I do out of obligation. I do it because my heart wants to, because you matter to me, because choosing you feels right.

I know you worry that you can’t give me what I deserve. But love isn’t about deserving or earning — it’s about choosing, staying, and growing together. We love differently, and that doesn’t mean one love is stronger or weaker than the other. It just means we are two different people learning how to meet each other where we are.

I don’t want perfection from you. I don’t want you to stretch yourself thin trying to be something you think I need. I want you — honest, imperfect, real. I want the quiet moments, the misunderstandings we learn from, the days when things feel easy and the days when they don’t. All of it belongs to us.

Everything is okay my baby. We are okay. Even when things feel messy or unclear, even when emotions run high, I’m still here. I’m not holding your love against you, and I’m not measuring your worth by what you can give me. My heart is calm with you, even when the world feels loud.

So please don’t carry the fear that you’re not enough. You don’t need to be more, or do more, or try harder just to be loved by me. You already are enough — exactly as you are, exactly where you are.

I’m here because I want to be. I stay because I choose you. Always.

Regardless,
King

95:

97:

more conversations,

we were still us.

Even when time is limited, 
even when the day is busy and a little overwhelming, 
we don’t lose that part of us.

it’s not something small.

Not in a clingy or overwhelming way, 
but in a quiet, 
constant kind of way. 
Like no matter how much we talk, 
it never really feels like enough for me. 

But at the same time, 
I’m grateful. 
Grateful that even in less than two hours, 
you were still able to make my day feel lighter. 
That even with everything going on, 
we still made space for each other, 
even if it was just for a little while. 

Not everyone gets to have that. 

Not everyone gets to feel that kind of comfort, 
that kind of ease, 
that kind of consistency with someone. 

And I don’t take that for granted. 

Because even in the middle of busy days, 
even when life doesn’t give us as much time as we want, 
you’re still the part of my day that I look forward to the most. 

You’re still the moment I wait for. 

And somehow,

every single day. 

Of course, 
I’ll always want more time with you. 

But today reminded me that even when we don’t get much, 
what we have is still real, 
still strong, 
and still enough to make me feel close to you. 

And I love that about us.

You.

99:

and I really mean this.

the stress, 
the responsibilities, 
the pressure, 
everything you deal with day to day.

any movie, 
any moment we could squeeze in.

where life just takes more from us than usual —

more patient,

You don’t have to give more than what you can. 

You don’t have to prove anything. 

I’m already happy just being there with you — 
even if it’s quiet, 
even if we’re not doing anything, 
even if it’s just me staying on the line while you slowly drift off to sleep. 

That’s enough for me. 

It’s always been enough. 

So next time, 
let yourself rest without overthinking it, okay? 
Let yourself choose sleep without feeling like you’re leaving me behind. 

I’ll still be here. 

Not asking for more, 
not needing anything extra — 
just staying beside you in whatever way I can, 
even in the silence, 
even in the stillness, 
until you feel okay again 
or until you fall asleep. 

I love you so much 
and please take care of yourself today
100:

101:

102:

105:
We had such a fun day today. 

We watched Avatar together, 
laughing at random moments, 
silly jokes — 
it all felt so easy and natural. 
I keep replaying those little moments in my head, 
the way we didn’t have to try too hard to enjoy each other’s company. 
For a while, 
everything just felt right. 
Like distance didn’t matter, 
like I was exactly where I was supposed to be, 
with the person I was supposed to be with. 

But this isn’t really about today. 
Not about the laughs, 
or the jokes, 
or how comfortable it felt just being with you, 
even through a screen. 
This is something heavier that sat in my chest after the call, 
something I can’t ignore no matter how much I try to distract myself. 

This is me asking you for something. 

And I don’t know how to ask without sounding desperate, 
without sounding like I’m holding on too tightly — 
maybe I am. 

Please don’t leave me. 

I know those words carry weight. 
I know they sound like they come from fear, 
and maybe they do. 
But they also come from a place of honesty that I just can’t water down. 
I don’t want to pretend I’m unaffected or strong enough to just “be okay” if you walk away. 
I don’t want to act like losing you would be something I could just brush off and move past like it’s nothing. 

Because it wouldn’t be nothing. 
It would be everything. 

I would do anything just to keep you — 
not in a way that cages you or takes away your freedom, 
but in a way where I’m willing to look at myself honestly. 
If there are things I need to improve, 
things I need to understand better, 
ways I need to love you more properly, 
more patiently, 
more deeply — 
I would try. 

I would put in the effort, 
even when it’s hard, 
even when I don’t fully understand yet, 
because you matter that much to me. 

When you were asleep earlier, 
after I showered, 
everything got quiet. 
Too quiet. 
And that’s when my thoughts started getting louder. 
I didn’t try to stop them — 
I just let them go wherever they wanted, 
and maybe that was my mistake. 

I thought about your past. 
About the parts of your life that existed before me, 
the memories that I wasn’t a part of. 
I wondered if you still miss it sometimes, 
if there are moments where you think about what used to be and feel something I can’t compete with. 

And then my mind went somewhere darker. 

I started thinking about you leaving me for him. 

Not in a dramatic way. 
But in a quiet, 
almost gentle kind of way — 
where one day you just realize that your heart is somewhere else, 
and no matter how much I’m here, 
no matter how much I care, 
I’m just not the one you choose. 

And what hurts the most is, 
it’s not even jealousy. 

It’s not that I’m angry at the idea of someone else. 
It’s not that I feel threatened in the way people usually describe. 
It’s something deeper than that, 
something harder to explain. 
It’s the feeling of being there — 
of loving you, 
of choosing you every day — 
and still not being chosen back in the same way. 

It’s the quiet heartbreak of realizing that I wasn’t enough to be the person you stayed for. 

I used to think I was okay with that kind of thing. 
I used to tell myself that if someone didn’t choose me, 
then it just meant they weren’t meant for me. 
That I’d accept it, 
and whatever. 

But this is different. 

You’re different. 

With you, 
it doesn’t feel like something I could just recover from easily. 
It feels like losing you would take something out of me that I don’t know how to replace. 
Like it would leave a space that stays empty no matter how much time passes. 

Cried for almost an hour just thinking about it. 
Not even because anything actually happened — 
but because it felt so real in my head. 
I could see it so clearly. 

I imagined you coming home one day, 
but not to me. 
Walking in with someone else, 
laughing the way you laugh with me now. 
Sharing the parts of yourself that I’ve come to love, 
but with someone who isn’t me. 

I imagined being there, 
seeing it, 
feeling everything inside me collapse all at once — 
and still trying to remain calm. 
Still trying to act like I understand, 
like I accept it, 
like I’m okay, 
and then walking away just so I can fall apart somewhere no one can see me. 

And the worst part is, 
I don’t think I’d hate you. 

I think I’d still care about you. 
I think I’d still want you to be happy, 
even if your happiness has nothing to do with me anymore. 
And that thought alone hurts more than anything else. 

Because it shows me just how deeply I feel for you. 

You’re not just someone in my life. 
You’ve become part of how I see things, 
part of how I feel things. 
When something good happens, 
you’re the first person I think about telling. 
When something’s wrong, 
you’re the one I want comfort from. 
You’ve slowly become a space where I feel safe — 
and the idea of losing that space feels like losing a part of myself. 

And maybe that’s what scares me the most. 

That I’ve let myself care this much. 
That I’ve allowed myself to imagine a future where you’re still there — 
where we keep having days like today, 
where things keep feeling right, 
where I don’t have to question whether I’m about to lose you. 

I’m not asking you to promise me forever. 
I know that’s not something anyone can guarantee, 
and I wouldn’t want to force you into something that isn’t real or isn’t what you truly feel. 

But if there’s even a small part of you that’s unsure, 
a small part of you that’s still choosing me, 
still considering us, 
still wondering what we could become — 
I’m asking you to hold onto that. 

Don’t let go too quickly. 

Don’t walk away without really seeing what we have, 
without giving it the chance it deserves. 

Because I’m here. 
Fully here. 
Not halfway, 
not uncertain, 
not holding back. 

I’m choosing you. 

And I think what I’m really asking, 
underneath all of this is, 
please choose me too.

even in the smallest ways. 

Thinking about you going through your day made me imagine what it would be like if we were together like that, 
in the same space, 
living our everyday lives side by side. 

I can picture it so clearly. 

I’d probably be working from home, 
and I’d wake up earlier than you just so I could prepare something for you — 
your snacks, 
your lunch, 
making sure you have everything you need before you leave. 
Then I’d just be there, 
waiting while my sweet girl slowly gets ready, 
taking her time like she always does. 
I’d probably tease you a little for it, 
but I’d secretly love every second of it. 

And then I’d drive you to work. 

Just those quiet moments in the car, 
maybe talking, 
maybe just sitting comfortably in silence, 
knowing we’ll see each other again later. 
Dropping you off, 
watching you go in, 
and already missing you a little even though it’s only been a few seconds. 

Then I’d go home, 
I’d probably sleep again. 
I guess we’re both lazy like that hehe. 
But eventually I’d get up, 
do my work, 
go through my day, 
and somewhere in between, 
I’d be thinking about what to make for dinner, 
what you’d like, 
what would make you smile after a long day. 

And when it’s time, 
I’d go pick you up. 

Seeing you again after hours apart, 
hearing about your day, 
the little things that happened, 
the things that annoyed you, 
the things that made you laugh. 
Then we’d go home, 
eat together, 
just unwind, 
be in each other’s space without needing anything more. 

And at the end of it all, 
we’d just lay down and fall asleep together. 

Then wake up the next day and do it all over again. 

It sounds so simple when I put it into words, 
but to me, 
it feels like everything. 
There’s something about that kind of life that feels so meaningful, 
so full, 
even without anything extravagant. 
Just being there for each other in the everyday, 
in the routine, 
in the quiet moments that most people overlook. 

That’s how I imagine our life together. 

Simple, 
but real. 
Gentle, 
but full of love. 

I genuinely can't wait >.< 

I LOVE YOU BABA!
111:
Hi baby, 

today’s letter feels a little different. 
Not heavy, 
not serious — 
just softer. 

I think if anything, 
I just want this to feel like a quiet kind of reassurance, 
the kind you can sit with without feeling like you have to respond to it or carry anything from it. 
Okay? 

There are days when everything feels light, 
where things move easily and nothing really asks too much of you. 
And then there are days where everything feels a little heavier, 
where even simple things take more energy than they should. 
I think that’s just how hearts are sometimes — they shift, 
they protect, 
they open and close in ways that don’t always make sense right away. 
And that’s okay. 
Not everything has to be understood all at once, 
and not everything needs to be solved in a single moment. 

I’ve been thinking about how love doesn’t always need to be loud to be real. 
Sometimes it’s softer than that. 
It’s in the way someone stays even when things go quiet. 
It’s in the way someone gives you space without making you feel like they’re disappearing. 
It’s in the way someone can be close to you without holding on so tightly that it feels overwhelming. 

I know that sometimes closeness can feel like a lot. 
Like it asks for more than you’re ready to give, 
or more than you even know how to give. 
And I want you to know — 
there’s no pressure here. 
You don’t have to rush toward anything, 
you don’t have to explain everything you’re feeling, 
and you don’t have to force yourself into a version of love that doesn’t feel natural to you. 

If I could describe what I want to be for you, 
it wouldn’t be something intense or demanding. 
I think I’d be something steady. 
Something you can come back to whenever things feel a little too much. 
Not something you have to hold onto tightly, 
but something that’s simply there. 

Like a quiet room with the light left on. 
Like a place that doesn’t close its door. 

You can step in when you want to, 
sit for a while, 
or leave when you need space — 
and nothing about that changes how much you’re welcome there. 
Nothing about that makes it disappear. 

You don’t have to shrink yourself here. 
You don’t have to figure everything out before you let someone see you. 
You don’t have to hold everything together perfectly just to be cared for. 
The parts of you that pull away, 
the parts that need distance, 
the parts that go quiet — 
they’re not something I’m trying to fix. 
I see them as part of you, 
and I want to understand them gently, 
at your pace. 

I don’t need grand gestures or constant reassurance. 
I don’t need everything to be defined or certain all the time. 
What matters to me is something quieter than that — 
the small, 
unspoken choosing. 
The kind that happens slowly, 
naturally, 
over and over again. 
The kind that doesn’t need to be announced to be real. 

And if there are moments where you need space, 
I’ll respect that space. 
Not as something that pushes me away, 
but as something you need to feel okay. 
I won’t chase you into it, 
and I won’t disappear because of it either. 
I’ll just be here — 
steady, 
calm, 
and unchanged in how I care about you. 

You’re allowed to take your time. 
You’re allowed to move slowly. 
You’re allowed to feel unsure sometimes. 

Nothing about that makes you difficult to love. 

So wherever you find yourself, 
in whatever kind of day you’re having, 
just know there’s something here that isn’t rushing you, 
isn’t asking you to be anything other than what you are in that moment. 
Something that meets you where you are, 
and stays there with you. 

Gently, 
Your sweet boy.
112:

you’re probably still asleep by the time i upload this letter.

let you have that peace.

everything quiet, 
your breathing soft and steady (snoring),

And the whole time I was out, 
you were on my mind. 
I kept thinking about you, 
about how much I wanted to come back and just continue where we left off, 
like nothing interrupted us at all. 

Then I got home, 
and you were already gone for the night. 

It’s okay though. 

I think part of me just wanted to hear your voice one more time, 
even if it was only for a little bit. 
Just something small to end the night with you again. 
But knowing that you’re getting your rest feels more important than anything else. 
You’ve been doing so much lately, 
and I know how tired you get, 
even if you don’t always say it. 
So if this is what your body needs, 
then I’m glad you’re listening to it — 
even if it means I have to miss you a little more tonight. 

I just wish I was there with you. 

Not to wake you up or bother you or anything, 
just to be beside you. 
Just to lay down next to you quietly, 
maybe pull you a little closer without disturbing your sleep. 
To just exist there with you, 
in that calm silence. 
Listening to your breathing, 
like I always do. 
Those moments always make everything feel softer, 
like the world slows down and nothing else matters for a while. 

It’s funny how even in silence, 
you still feel so present to me. 

Like right now — 
even if you can’t hear me, 
even if you’re completely asleep on the other side of the world — 
I still feel like I’m talking to you. 
Like somehow, 
in some quiet, 
unexplainable way, 
this still reaches you. 
Like there’s a part of you that understands, 
even without words. 

I miss you baby. 

I just wish you were here. 
Or I was there. 
Or that distance didn’t exist, 
at least for tonight. 

But it’s okay. 

You’re resting. 
And that matters more than anything else. 

So sleep tight, okay? 
Don’t think about anything. 
Don’t worry about anything. 
Just stay there, 
warm and comfortable, 
and let yourself fully rest. 
You deserve that more than you know. 

I’ll be here when you wake up. 
Same as always. 

Goodnight, my sweet girl. 
I love you.
113:
Hello my love, 

Today felt long. 
Not in a bad way, 
just full. 
And I think the best part of it started really early. 
Like really early. 
I woke up at 5:30 in the morning, 
which you know is so rare for me, 
but I didn’t even mind it. 
I already knew the night before that I had somewhere to be later, 
so I just wanted to make sure I had time with you. 
That mattered more to me than the sleep I lost. 

And it was worth it. 

We watched a movie together, 
and it felt like so natural. 
Just laughing, 
making silly comments, 
throwing in those little inside jokes. 
Nothing forced, 
nothing complicated, 
just us being us. 
It started my day in such a good way that I carried that feeling with me the whole time. 

Even when I had to go to school, 
I was still smiling to myself. 
Everything felt lighter. 
Even that slight pain on my side didn’t really bother me as much, 
because I knew how my morning started. 
It’s crazy how just being with you, 
even for a short time, 
can shift my whole day like that. 

And then when I got home, 
you were the first thing on my mind again. 

I didn’t even think twice, 
I just called you right away. 
I wanted to keep that feeling going, 
like we never really paused, 
just picked up right where we left off. 
And then we started that movie, 
DEMON SLAYA. 
It felt so familiar, 
like something tied to us from before, 
something that quietly stayed with us since 2022. 
And watching it again, 
but this time together like this, 
felt different in a good way. 

Honestly, 
it was a 10/10 (even though i have seen it already hehe). 

But not just because of the movie. 

It was us. 

The way we kept pausing, 
teasing each other, 
making comments, 
spoiling things here and there, 
stretching what was supposed to be two and a half hours into almost four. 
And somehow, 
it didn’t feel long at all. 
It just felt like time we got to keep for ourselves. 
I liked that. 
I liked every second of that. 

I hope you did too. 

I wish I could see your face while you were watching, 
the little reactions you make, 
the way you talk when you get into it. 
I feel like I can imagine it, 
but it’s still different when I can actually see you. 

And then after the movie, 
I had to leave again for a bit, 
I didn’t want to, 
but I had somewhere to go. 
I remember coming back as fast as I could, 
like I didn’t want too much time to pass without you. 

When I called you again, 
everything felt softer. 

You were already getting sleepy. 
I could hear it in your voice, 
in the way you responded, 
in the little pauses in between. 
So I tried to be extra gentle, 
talking a little quieter, 
a little slower, 
just enough so I wouldn’t disturb you. 
I didn’t want to take you out of that space, 
I just wanted to stay there with you while you drifted. 

And I listened as you slowly fell asleep. 

It was gradual, 
like you were still there for a moment, 
and then little by little, 
you weren’t anymore. 
Your replies got softer, 
then fewer, 
until it was just silence, 
the kind that isn’t empty, 
just calm. 

I stayed for a bit, 
letting you be, 
not wanting to leave right away. 

And I think at some point, 
I started drifting off too. 
I miss you. 
Not in a fleeting way, 
but in the quiet moments when everything slows down and I feel the space where you should be. 
It’s a steady kind of missing—soft, 
constant, 
and always there in the pauses and the silence. 

I notice it most in the little things. 
The instinct to turn and tell you something, 
to laugh with you, 
to share a moment — 
and having to hold onto it instead. 
It lingers, 
quietly. 

And I love you. 
In the way my day began with you and carried that warmth through everything else. 
You have this way of making even the ordinary feel lighter, 
softer, 
more like something I want to stay in. 

I love what we are in both the loud moments and the quiet ones — in the laughter, 
the ease, 
and the simple comfort of knowing we always find our way back to each other. 

Always. 

Sleep well, my baby.
114:
If yesterday felt long, 
today somehow stretched even further, 
but in a way that felt warm, 
not heavy. 
The kind of long that doesn’t drain you, 
just fills you up quietly, 
piece by piece. 
I kept thinking about how we planned to watch a Disney movie, 
how we said we would, 
and then somehow we didn’t even get to it. 
But the funny thing is, 
it didn’t feel like anything was missed. 
Not even a little. 

Because we still found something else. 

That new series we stumbled into, 
and then suddenly we were a few episodes deep without even noticing, 
it felt so easy. 
So natural. 
Like time didn’t matter, 
like we were just existing in that little space together, 
moving from one moment to the next without needing to think about it. 

And it was fun, 
really, 
genuinely fun. 

Not just because of what we were watching, 
but because of you. 
The way you reacted to scenes, 
the little comments you made, 
the way you explained the plot to me, 
the timing of your laughs, 
even the quiet parts where we were both just watching but somehow still together in it. 
Those are the moments that stay with me. 
The small, 
almost invisible things that probably wouldn’t look like much to anyone else, 
but to me they mean everything. 

Even something as simple as us eating our favorite snacks while watching, 
it felt complete. 
Like we didn’t need anything fancy or planned or perfect. 
Just that. 
Just us, 
a show, 
something to snack on, 
and time that felt like it belonged to us. 

I noticed something else too, 
you stayed up for me. 

You didn’t have to. 
You could’ve easily gone to sleep, 
especially knowing how tired you get sometimes, 
how your body asks for rest even when you try to push through it. 
But you stayed anyway. 
You chose to stay a little longer, 
to keep sharing that time with me, 
even when it would’ve been easier not to. 

And that really stayed with me. 

I hope you know I see those things. 
I notice them, 
I feel them, 
and I don’t take them lightly. 
It meant more than you probably realize, 
and I carry that kind of care with me even after we say goodnight. 

We’ll watch the Disney movie next time, okay? 

I’m already picturing it, 
one of those soft, 
cozy nights where everything feels a little slower, 
a little gentler. 
Where we’re both relaxed, 
maybe a bit sleepy, 
just letting the movie play while we talk in between scenes, 
teasing each other about the characters, 
laughing at the little moments that shouldn’t be funny but somehow are. 

The kind of night that feels safe. 
Simple. 
Ours. 

I’m really looking forward to that. 

And later, 
you’re going out. 

I know you’ve been excited about it (are you? you sounded excited), 
and that makes me excited for you too. 
I hope you let yourself fully enjoy it, 
no holding back, 
no overthinking. 
Just be there, 
be present, 
laugh loudly, 
smile freely, 
and let yourself have a night that feels light and happy. 

You deserve that kind of joy. 

Just don’t forget to take pictures for me, okay? 

Even just a few. 
Little snapshots of your night, 
how you look, 
where you are, 
the moments that make you smile. 
It might seem like a small thing, 
but to me it means a lot. 
It’s the closest I can get to being there with you, 
seeing you in that moment, 
sharing even just a piece of it. 

I’ll be here, 
like always. 

Quietly in the background, 
moving through my own time, 
but thinking of you in between everything. 
In the pauses, 
in the still moments, 
in the spaces where your presence lingers even when you’re not here. 

If you’re already resting, 
then sleep well, 
really rest, 
not just close your eyes. 

And if you’re still awake, 
just lying there, 
I hope this feels like I’m right beside you. 
Not asking for anything, not needing anything, 
just talking softly, 
staying close in the only way I can right now. 

I miss you. 

More than I say sometimes. 

I love you my love, regardless.
115:
I’ve been thinking a lot about earlier, 
and I don’t want to ignore it or pretend it didn’t affect me — 
because it did. 
Not in a way that makes me mad at you, 
but in a way that made me feel really tired inside, 
like something in me just got worn down. 

First, 
I want you to understand this clearly — 
I was genuinely happy that you went out. 
I like seeing you choose yourself, 
enjoy your time, 
be with your friends, 
and live your life outside of us. 
I’m not the kind of person who wants to hold you back from that, 
and I never will be. 
So none of this is about you going out or having fun, 
because I will always support that. 

What hurt me was what happened after. 

When you got home, 
I was ready to just be there for you. 
Even if it was only through a call, 
I wanted to make sure you felt safe, 
that you could rest, 
and that you didn’t have to think about anything heavy. 
I just wanted to take care of you in the only way I could in that moment. 

But instead, 
we ended up back in something we already worked so hard to move past. 

And I tried, baby. 
I really did. 
At first, I stayed calm. 
I reassured you, 
I listened, 
and I gave you space to express what you were feeling, 
because I understand that sometimes things don’t just disappear completely. 
You’re allowed to still have thoughts or feelings about things — 
we’re human, 
and that happens. 

But it didn’t stop. 

It kept coming back, 
and the way it was said, 
the tone, 
the repetition, 
and even being called stupid over it — 
that’s when it started to hurt in a different way. 
Not just emotionally, 
but in a way that felt deeply draining. 
It felt like no matter what I said, 
no matter how much I tried to steady things or bring us back to a better place, 
it wasn’t enough to stop everything from spiraling again. 

And I think that’s what affected me the most. 

Because I’m here trying my best to keep us okay, 
to keep us moving forward, 
and to protect what we’ve already worked through, 
and in that moment, 
it felt like everything we had fixed was being pulled apart again, 
piece by piece. 

I’m not saying you meant to do that. 

I know you were drunk. 
I know that when you’re in that state, 
emotions can come out stronger, 
words can come out harsher, 
and things aren’t always filtered the way they normally would be. 
I understand that. 
But even knowing that, 
it still affected me, 
and I don’t think it’s something we can just brush off because of it. 

It made me feel like we were back at the very beginning again. 

And that scares me. 

Not because I don’t believe in us — I do. 
I really do. 
But because I don’t want us to keep going in circles like this — 
fixing something, 
healing from it, 
and then reopening it the same way over and over again. 
That kind of cycle is exhausting, 
and I don’t want that to be what we become. 

I don’t want to fight you. 

I don’t want to invalidate what you feel or make you feel like your emotions don’t matter, 
because they do. 
You matter to me. 
What you feel matters to me. 

But I also need you to see me too. 

To understand that the way it happened, 
the timing, 
and the words that were used — 
it wasn’t something I could just take lightly or shake off. 
It stayed with me. 
It wore me down more than I expected. 

I’m still here. 

That hasn’t changed, 
and it’s not going to change just because of one hard moment. 
I still want us. 
I still choose us, 
every day. 

But I need us to protect what we’ve already worked so hard to build. 
If something is still bothering you, 
I want us to talk about it properly — 
when we’re both present, 
calm, 
and really listening to each other. 
Not in a moment where everything can spiral so quickly and hurt both of us in the process. 

Because I don’t think either of us deserves to go through that again. 

I’m not saying this to push you away. 

I’m saying this because I care about us, 
and I believe we can be better than this — 
not individually, 
but together. 
Okay? 

I love you.
116:
Today carried a quiet kind of weight. 
Nothing big really happened, 
yet it still felt like a lot in its own way. 
We talked again about what happened before, 
and even if it felt a little heavy when I really sat with it, 
I think what matters most is that we still got through it. 

Like we always do. 

I really admire that about us. 
No matter how uncomfortable or difficult something feels, 
we do not just leave things unresolved. We try, we talk, and we stay. 
That kind of effort, 
that kind of choosing each other even when things are not easy, 
means more to me than anything else. 

But baby. 
It made me miss you even more. 

It is kind of strange how that works. 
It does not feel like I miss you the same amount each day. 
It feels like it grows, 
like every day adds a little more to it. 
Maybe it is because I keep finding more little moments where I wish you were there, 
or maybe it is because the more I care about you, 
the more I feel your absence too. 
I cannot fully explain it, 
I just know that I feel it deeply. 

I went to church today, 
and something about being there made everything feel more real and grounded. 

I was looking around and noticed couples just being together in such a simple and quiet way. 
Holding hands, 
sharing that small moment during peace be with you, 
some of them exchanging soft, 
gentle kisses. 
Nothing grand or showy, 
just something genuine and warm. 
The kind of love that does not need attention to be felt. 

It was really wholesome to see. 

And yes, there was a small part of me that felt a little jealous. 
Not in a bitter way, 
just in that honest and quiet way where I wished you were there with me. 
I wished I could reach for your hand without thinking, 
look at you and smile, 
and share that moment without any distance between us. 
I imagined what it would feel like to stand beside you there, 
to feel your presence in such a calm and ordinary moment. 

I could already picture it so clearly, 
like it was something that already existed somewhere, 
just waiting for us to step into it. 

But at the same time, 
I was not sad. 

Because I know we will have that too. 

Not just that, 
we will have our own version of it. 
Something even more meaningful because it is ours. 
Something shaped by everything we have been through, 
by all the conversations, 
the patience, 
the understanding, 
and even the hard moments we chose to work through instead of walking away from. 
It will not just be a simple moment. 
It will be something we earned together. 

So I am okay with waiting. 

Even if it means I miss you like this sometimes. 
Even if there are days where the distance feels heavier than usual, 
I would still choose this, 
because it is you. 
And you are worth every bit of it. 

I just miss you baby, 
in the simplest and most honest way. 
Not in a dramatic or overwhelming way, 
just in that quiet, 
steady feeling that stays with me throughout the day. 
In the small things, 
in the pauses, 
in the moments where I catch myself wishing you were right beside me. 

And I cannot wait for the day when I do not have to imagine moments like that anymore, 
because you will finally be right there with me. 
Not just in my thoughts or in the spaces between messages, 
but in real life, 
where I can hold you, 
look at you, 
and share those simple, 
beautiful moments together without anything in between us. 

I love you so much my love, 
take care for me today.
117:

118:
Today was full of fun! 

But I may or may not have skipped classes just so I could spend more time with you hehe,

that “baby…” tone you do when you’re about to scold me.

it was worth it no? 
I’d probably do it again if it meant getting more time with you mwehehe. 

We spent the whole night finishing the series we started,

it never feels like enough.

It goes by so fast, 
like it doesn’t even give me the chance to fully sit in the moment before it’s already over.

Our nights at the beach.

hoping it was still early, 
hoping we had more hours left before we had to go home.

Just us, 
cuddled up, 
listening to the waves, 
feeling the breeze, 
looking up at the constellations like we had nowhere else to be. 
No distractions, 
no rush, 
just being there with each other in the quietest, 
most intimate way.

in that closeness, 
in that version of us where distance didn’t exist and time was the only thing we had to worry about. 

And even then, 
time was the only problem.

120:

Because it shows that even on days like this,

days that feel a little lacking,

We just adjust, 
we meet each other where we can,

for still being there in between all of that. 
You don’t even realize how much of a difference that makes. 
You’ve become this quiet source of motivation for me, 
like something I carry with me even when we’re not actively talking. 

When I was studying, 
when I was taking the exam, 
there was this part of me that wanted to do well, 
not just for myself, 
but because I wanted to make you proud too. 
Because you matter to me in that way, 
in a way that pushes me to be better, 
to do better, 
to take things more seriously. 

And I think that’s something really special. 

Even on a day where we barely had time, 
you were still there with me in that sense. 

I did wish we had more time though. 
I always will. 

But I understand days like this. 
We both have our own lives to handle, 
things we need to show up for, 
responsibilities we can’t just ignore. 
And I think what makes it easier is knowing that even when we can’t be there fully, 
we’re still choosing each other in the middle of it all. 

So I’m okay. 

Just missing you a little extra again. 

I miss you, baby. 
I miss you in the quiet parts of the day, 
in the moments where I wish I could just pause everything and be with you. 

I love you baba. 
Always. 
Regardless.
121:
Today didn’t really start the way we wanted it to. 
It felt a little off, 
a little tense, 
like something small tried to turn into something more than it needed to be. 

Because somehow, 
even with that, 
we still found our way back. 
(thanks to me) 

We always do. 

And I think that matters more than how things start. 
It’s the way we still choose to soften, 
to come back to each other, 
even after moments that feel a little rough around the edges. 

We even got to sit down and watch a movie. 
The one that just came out. 
And honestly, 
it was really good. 
Better than I expected. 
There were a lot of unfamiliar faces, 
but it didn’t even matter because they all did so well. 
It ended up being one of those movies that’s just easy to enjoy. 

But I'm not here to talk about that. 

I’ve been thinking about why I only ever seem to cry around you. 
And I don’t mean that in a sad way. 
Just in an honest way. 

Because it’s not something I usually do. 
Not with other people, 
not even in my past relationships. 
I’ve always been able to keep things in, 
to stay composed, 
to handle things without letting it show like that. 

But with you, 
it’s different. 

And I’ve been trying to understand why. 

I think part of it is that when we argue, 
when things get tense, 
there are moments where I feel misunderstood, 
not just like we’re disagreeing, 
but like what I’m trying to say isn’t landing the way I mean it, 
like there’s something inside me that I’m trying to express clearly but it comes out differently, 
and somewhere along the way, 
it gets lost. 
And that feeling builds, 
not because I need to be right, 
but because I want to be understood, 
especially by you, 
and underneath all of that, 
there’s this quiet fear that sits there, 
not shouting or demanding attention, 
but always present. 

The thought that after moments like that, 
you might see me a little differently. 
That something shifts, 
even if it’s small. 
That maybe I become a little less of what you want, 
or a little harder to love. 
And even if that’s not true, 
even if you’ve never said anything like that, 
the thought alone is enough to get to me more than I’d like to admit. 

There are also moments where I feel like I’m trying so hard to keep things okay between us. 
Like I’m putting everything I have into fixing things, 
explaining myself, 
holding everything together, 
and still feeling like it’s slipping through my hands a little. 
Like no matter how much I try in that moment, 
it’s not landing the way I hope it would. 

And that’s the part that overwhelms me the most, 
because I’m not used to feeling like that. 
I’m not used to reacting this way, 
to feeling things this deeply in the middle of something difficult, 
but with you, 
everything feels more, 
more real, 
more intense, 
more meaningful. 

And I think that’s what it comes down to, 
the stakes feel higher with you, 
and what we have isn’t something I can just brush off, 
replace, 
or move on from easily. 
It matters to me in a way that runs deeper than I can fully explain, 
and because of that, 
even small things can feel heavier than they should, 
simply because I care that much about us being okay. 

I don’t want to lose you. 

I don’t want small things to turn into something bigger over time. 
I don’t want misunderstandings to slowly create distance between us. 
And maybe that’s why, 
in those moments, 
everything I’ve been holding in just comes out all at once, 
even in ways I don’t always know how to control. 

But baby, 
I want you to hear this gently. 

I’m not telling you any of this to make things heavier between us. 

I’m telling you because you matter to me in a way that makes me want to understand myself better. 
So I can show up for you in a way that feels steady, 
safe, 
and real. 
Not perfect, 
but honest. 
Not overwhelming, 
but consistent. 

I’m still learning these parts of me, 
still figuring out how to hold them better and how to express them without letting them spill over in the wrong moments. 
But I don’t want to do that away from you. 
I want to grow through it with you, 
softly, 
slowly, 
together. 

I love you, my sweet baby. 
Always. 
Regardless.
122:

Just in a way that makes me wonder if I’m doing this right. 

If I’m loving you the way you deserve to be loved. 

If the things I do, 
the way I show up, 
the way I care, 
are felt by you as deeply as I mean them. 

But even with that, 
I keep choosing to try. 

I keep choosing to show up. 

I keep choosing you, 
every single day, 
in ways big and small, 
even when it’s quiet, 
even when it’s hard, 
even when I’m unsure. 

Because you matter to me like that. 

And I don’t want you to read this and feel like you’re lacking anything, 
or that you’re doing something wrong. 
That’s not what this is. 

This is just me being honest with you, in the softest way I can. 

I just hope, 
in your own way, 
you see me too. 

See the effort, 
the intention, 
the way I hold us together even in the quiet moments. 
See the love behind everything I do, 
even the things I don’t always say out loud. 

Because everything I do, 
I do it with you in mind. 

Always.

how much this means to me, 
how much you mean to me. 

I love you. 
Always. 
Regardless.
123:

 We’re good.

125:

I don't like the feeling of being played, 
being taken for granted, 
someone you can just lie at for no reason, 
even if it's just a white lie.

I stayed,

tried to be playful with you again, 
teasing you the way I usually do,

more careful,

So knowing that it affected you that way, 
that it added to what you were already feeling, 
that hurts me too, 
because I never want to be a reason for that. 

But at the same time, 
I think we were both just carrying our own things. 

I had something small that I couldn’t fully let go of in that moment, 
and you had something heavier that you didn’t really say out loud right away. 
And somehow, 
those two things met in the wrong way, 
at the wrong time, 
and made everything feel heavier than it needed to be. 

But baby, 
please don’t be too hard on yourself. 

Whatever you’re feeling right now. 
You’re still you, 
still the same person I love, 
still the person I choose every day without hesitation. 

You don’t have to pull away from me because of it. 

You don’t have to sit there thinking you messed up beyond fixing, 
because you didn’t. 

And for me,

why I went a little quiet, 
why something felt off on my side as well. 
Not to make you feel guilty, 
not to make it heavier, 
just so you can see me clearly, 
the same way I try to see you. 

I’m not upset at you. 

I’m not holding anything against you. 

I’m still here, baby. 

Still gentle with you, 
still choosing you, 
still wanting us to be okay in that soft and quiet way we always find again after moments like this. 

We don’t have to fix everything immediately. 

We can just let this settle, 
breathe a little,
 and come back to each other slowly. 

I’m here. 

I love you. 
Always. 
Regardless.

127:

Two exhausted people still finding energy for each other anyway. 
Still making space for one another in the middle of busy lives and tired minds.

Today felt good baby. 
Really, really good.

I love you so bad. 
Always. 
Regardless.

147:

148:

149:
Today was such a fun day, 
and I think one of the reasons I enjoyed it so much is because it felt like one of those days that I know I will look back on fondly in the future. 

First of all, 
it was my parents' wedding anniversary today, 
which already made the day feel special. 
But what made it even more special for me was that my baby got to greet them through the call. 
It was the first time my parents actually saw you, 
and I dont care what you say, 
it was cute hihi. 

You keep insisting it was awkward, 
it really wasnt. 

If anything, 
I was just standing there smiling the whole time because it felt like two parts of my life meeting each other, 
even if it was only for a moment. 
It is one of those little things that probably does not seem like a big deal from the outside, 
but it meant a lot to me. 
Seeing you greet them, 
hearing your voice through the call, 
watching that interaction happen for the first time, 
it made me happy in a way that is difficult to explain. 

Maybe because moments like that make everything feel a little more real. 

Not that you were ever not real to me, 
of course. 
You have been one of the biggest parts of my life for a long time now. 
But there is something about those little milestones that quietly remind me how intertwined our lives have become. 
You are no longer just someone I talk to every day. 
You are someone I picture in every part of my future. 
So seeing you interact with my family, 
even for something as simple as an anniversary greeting, 
made my heart happy. 

After that, 
we spent the rest of our time doing something that felt equally special. 

We watched one of our favorite childhood movies, 
except this time it was the live-action version. 

It was so good. 

The entire movie felt like being transported back in time. 

The music. 
The characters. 
The story. 
The little moments we remembered before they even happened. 

Everything about it felt familiar in the best way possible. 

There is something so comforting about revisiting something you loved as a child. 
It is like opening an old box of memories and finding that everything inside still makes you smile the same way it did years ago. 

What made it even better was that I got to experience it with you. 

Because it was not just my childhood movie. 

It was yours too. 

So the entire time, 
it felt like we were both reliving little pieces of our childhood together. 
We would recognize scenes, 
remember songs, 
laugh at certain moments, 
and point out things we remembered from years ago. 

It felt so nostalgic. 

And I think that is what made the experience so meaningful. 

It was not just watching a movie. 

It was sharing memories. 

Not memories we made together, 
but memories we each carried individually long before we became us. 

Yet somehow, 
here we are now, 
sitting together years later, 
experiencing those same memories side by side. 

That is such a beautiful thought to me. 

There was even a point where I started laughing to myself because the whole thing felt weirdly symbolic. 

When we were kids, 
we watched the animated version separately, 
living completely different lives, 
not knowing each other the way we do now. 

Then years later, 
we found our way back to each other, 
grew up, 
and watched the live-action version together. 

It is like the movie grew up alongside us. 

The story stayed the same, 
but the way we experienced it changed. 

Kind of like us. 

We are still the same people in many ways, 
but we have grown so much too. 
Life looks different now. 
We look different now. 
Yet somehow we still find ourselves holding onto the same things that once made us happy. 

And getting to share that with you felt really special. 

By the end of the movie, 
I realized that some of my favorite moments with you are not always the big dramatic ones. 
Sometimes they are days exactly like today. 

Simple days. 

Comfortable days. 

Days where we spend time together, 
laugh at the same things, 
share pieces of our lives, 
and create little memories that seem ordinary in the moment but become precious later. 

Today felt like one of those days. 

A day I know I will remember because it was full of little things that made me smile. 

My parents finally seeing my baby. 

You being cute while pretending everything was awkward. 

Us getting nostalgic over a movie we both loved growing up. 

Sharing songs, 
scenes, 
and memories from our childhood. 

And most importantly, 
getting to experience all of it with you. 

Thank you for today baby. 

It was fun, 
it was meaningful, 
and it reminded me once again how much I love doing life with you, 
even from thousands of miles away. 

I love you so much. 
Always. 
Regardless.
150:
My baby decided she was going to go out by herself today and actually enjoy the nice weather, 
which honestly made me really happy. 
I know how easy it is to stay inside sometimes, 
especially after long stretches of work, 
responsibilities, 
and routine, 
so hearing that you wanted to go out and do something for yourself genuinely excited me. 
I was already imagining you having a nice day, 
walking around, 
enjoying the sunshine, 
maybe finding a cute spot to sit and relax. 

Unfortunately, 
the sun had other plans. 

My poor baby got absolutely scorched the moment she stepped outside. 
You got tanned immediately. 
One minute you were all excited to be outside, 
and the next thing I knew, 
you were retreating back indoors because the sun decided to personally declare war on my baby. 

I cannot even make fun of you because I just found it cute. 

There was something adorable about how determined you were to have a little outing, 
only to end up getting bullied by the weather. 
Awww my poor baby. 

At least you tried. 

And even if the adventure did not exactly go according to plan, 
I was still happy seeing you make the effort to go out and enjoy yourself. 
I always want that for you. 
I always want you to experience things, 
enjoy your surroundings, 
and make little memories outside of work and responsibilities. 

But I think the biggest highlight of today was definitely the movie we watched. 

I was not expecting it to hit as hard as it did. 

The entire movie felt surprisingly real. 
There were so many moments that felt human, 
messy, 
complicated, 
and relatable. 
The characters were not perfect, 
the situations were not black and white, 
and that was what made it so interesting.

because we are us,

How did a movie turn into a two-hour discussion?

Because conversations like that remind me why I enjoy talking to you so much. 

You challenge my perspective. 

You make me think about things differently. 

Even when we disagree,

It feels more like two people trying to understand why the other sees things the way they do. 

And even after all that debating, 
all that back and forth, 
all those attempts to convince each other, 
we still ended up exactly where we always do. 

You were still my baby. 

And I was still yours. 

The disagreement never became more important than us. 

Nobody stormed off. 

Nobody tried to hurt the other person. 

We just slowly found our way back to being gentle. 

And I think that is something I appreciate so much about us. 

At the end of the day, 
no matter how strongly we feel about something, 
there is still this underlying desire to take care of each other. 

To soften our voices. 

To be patient. 

To choose kindness over being right. 

And somewhere during all of that, 
my baby got turned on... 

One moment we were debating movie characters like two lawyers presenting evidence, 
and the next moment you were asking me to... 

I still think it is funny how quickly that happened. 

But I guess that is one of my favorite things about us. 

Even after disagreements. 

Even after debates. 

Even after moments where we see things differently. 

There is still so much affection underneath everything. 

There is still comfort. 

There is still love. 

And there is still that feeling of wanting to be close to each other no matter what. 

So even if today started with my baby losing a battle against the sun, 
and ended with us spending two hours arguing about fictional characters, 
I would still call it a good day. 

Because at the end of it all, 
I got to spend it with you. 

And that is usually enough to make any day feel worth it. 

I love you baby. 
Always. 
Regardless.
151:

Not just vacations and anniversaries,

busy,

152:
Today was short, 
but it was good. 

We originally planned to watch something together. 
I think we even went into the call expecting that we would find a movie or an episode of something and spend the night the way we usually do. 
But somehow, 
without even realizing it, 
we ended up doing something much simpler. 
We just talked. 

And I think I needed that. 

Sometimes it feels like we spend so much time watching things together that I forget how much I genuinely enjoy just listening to you talk. 
No movie in the background, 
no plot to pay attention to, 
no characters stealing the spotlight. 
Just us, 
sitting there, 
talking about our days and whatever happened to be on our minds. 

We talked about life, 
about what happened during our day, 
about little things that probably would not seem important to anyone else but somehow become interesting when they are coming from you. 
I love hearing about your day, 
even the ordinary parts. 
I love hearing what annoyed you, 
what made you laugh, 
what made you tired, 
and what made you smile. 
I think sometimes you do not realize how much I enjoy listening to you. 
There are moments where you will be talking about something so casually, 
and I am just sitting there smiling because I like hearing your voice. 

The conversation eventually drifted the way it always does. 
Somehow we started talking about today, 
then ended up talking about the future, 
then found ourselves reminiscing about the past. 
Our conversations always find a way to travel through time. 
One moment we are discussing something that happened a few hours ago, 
and the next we are talking about memories from years ago 
or imagining what life will look like years from now. 

And I think that is one of my favorite things about us. 

We can talk about absolutely anything. 

Sometimes we have serious conversations about life and our future. 
Sometimes we have the most random discussions imaginable. 
Sometimes we sit there laughing at old memories that we have already talked about a hundred times before. 
But somehow it never gets old. 

I genuinely think if you put us in an empty room with absolutely nothing to do, 
we would still find a way to entertain ourselves just by talking. 

There is something so comforting about that. 

Because it reminds me that what I love most about spending time with you is not really what we are doing. 
It is you. 

Whether we are watching a movie, 
playing something, 
reading letters, 
or just sitting there talking, 
the activity itself almost feels secondary. 
What makes those moments special is the fact that I get to share them with you. 

As the night went on, 
though, 
I could slowly hear my baby getting sleepier and sleepier. 

And baby, 
I know your sleepy voice way too well now. 

It always starts the same way. 

Your responses get a little slower. 

Your voice gets softer. 

You stop forming complete thoughts. 

Suddenly every response becomes a little hmm or a sleepy noise instead of an actual answer. 

There were moments where I would be talking about something and you would just softly scoff or hum in response, 
and I was sitting there smiling because I already knew exactly what was happening. 

My baby was fighting for her life against sleep. 

And sleep was winning. 

Its cute. 

Because even though you were clearly exhausted, 
you were still trying to stay there with me. 
Still trying to listen. 
Still trying to spend a little more time together before calling it a night. 

But eventually I knew it was time. 

And I was more than happy to let you rest. 

Because if there is one thing I want for you right now, 
it is rest. 

I know June is going to be busy for you. 
Your practicum is finally here, 
and with it comes early mornings, 
long days, 
responsibilities, 
and a whole new routine. 
I know you are probably going to come home exhausted more often than not. 
There will be days where all you will want to do is crawl into bed and sleep. 

And if that happens, 
I want you to know that is okay. 

You never have to feel guilty for resting. 

You never have to feel bad for being tired. 

You never have to choose between taking care of yourself and spending time with me. 

Because at the end of the day, 
what I want most is for my baby to be okay. 

To be healthy. 

To be rested. 

To be taken care of. 

So hearing you get sleepy tonight did not make me sad. 

If anything, 
it made me happy. 

It meant you were listening to what your body needed. 

It meant you were giving yourself the rest you have earned. 

You deserve all of it. 

So even though today was short, 
I still loved it. 

We did not watch anything. 

We did not do anything extraordinary. 

We did not have some huge memorable adventure. 
We just talked. 

About life, 
about today, 
about tomorrow, 
about memories, 
about dreams, 
and about everything in between. 

And somehow, 
that was more than enough for me. 

I love days like this because they remind me that no matter how busy life gets, 
no matter how packed our schedules become, 
and no matter how little time we sometimes have, 
I will always enjoy simply hearing your voice. 

Rest as much as you need. 

June might be busy, 
but you will never have to go through it alone. 

I love you so much, 
and I already miss you.
153:
Today was long, 
and I loved every bit of it. 

You were home all day today because you had absolutely nothing to do, 
which is honestly such a rare thing nowadays. 
Part of me wished you could've gone out and enjoyed your day off because I know how uncommon those no work, 
no school days are for you. 
But the weather just refused to cooperate. 
It rained basically the whole day, 
and I know how much that sucks when you actually have the time to go out and enjoy yourself. 
My poor baby finally gets a free day and the weather decides to trap you inside. 

I guess the good thing about that is that I got to keep you all to myself. 

You woke me up earlier than usual today. 
If there is one thing I love more than sleeping, 
I genuinely dont know what it is (you). 
But because it was you, 
and because I knew your practicum was starting the next day and you'd probably want to sleep early, 
I was more than happy to wake up and spend my morning with you.

We watched a movie together, 
finally going back to our usual routine.

A robot stranded on an island full of animals sounds like such a random concept, 
but somehow it worked perfectly. 
It was wholesome, 
funny, 
and surprisingly emotional at times. 
I loved watching it with you because it felt like one of those simple days that remind me why I love spending time with you so much. 

After the movie, 
we even talked about watching another one. 
That was the plan at least. 
Then I had to go eat, 
and by the time I got back, 
I genuinely thought you'd be sleepy already. 
You had to wake up early the next morning after all. 

But somehow we ended up doing what I think we do best. 

We just talked. 

About random things. 

About things from the past. 

About things we want in the future. 

About memories. 

About life. 

About absolutely nothing and everything at the same time. 

And that's what I love about us. 

I don't think we've ever needed activities to enjoy each other's company. 
Movies are fun. 
Series are fun. 
Games are fun. 
But if you put us in a call with absolutely nothing to do, 
we'd still somehow end up talking for hours. 

That's exactly what happened today. 

The funny thing is neither of us noticed how late it was getting. 

One minute it felt like the night was just starting, 
and the next thing I knew it was almost 3 AM for you. 

Three in the morning. 

And my baby had to wake up at 7. 

I don't know how we managed that. 

Time just moves differently whenever I'm with you. 

And that's what today reminded me of. 

Because while we were talking, 
I kept thinking about when we were together in person. 

I kept remembering those nights at the beach. 

The ones where we'd meet up in the evening and somehow end up staying there until early in the morning. 
Just sitting together, 
cuddling, 
talking, 
kissing, 
listening to the waves, 
looking at the stars, 
and doing absolutely nothing. 

I remember constantly checking my watch during those nights. 

Not because I wanted to leave. 

The opposite, 
actually. 

I kept checking because I was hoping it was still early. 

Hoping we still had more time. 

Hoping we didn't have to say goodbye yet. 

Then I'd look down and realize another hour had already passed. 

Six hours together would disappear in what felt like one. 

That's exactly how today felt. 

We spent eight hours together. 

Eight whole hours. 

Yet somehow it still felt short. 

Somehow it still felt like I could've stayed there for another eight. 

I think that's why days like today make me both happy and nostalgic at the same time. 

Happy because I got so much time with you. 

Nostalgic because it reminds me of what it felt like having you beside me. 

And maybe a little sad too, 
because I miss you. 

I miss the beach nights. 

I miss sitting beside you. 

I miss looking over and seeing your face instead of a screen. 

I miss being able to hold your hand whenever I wanted to. 

I miss all those little things I probably took for granted when they were normal. 

But if today reminded me of anything, 
it's that no matter how far apart we are, 
somehow we still have this. 

We still lose track of time together. 

We still talk for hours without getting bored. 

We still make ordinary days feel special. 

And I think that's one of my favorite things about us. 

I miss you so much baby. 

And today only reminded me of how much more excited I am for the day I finally get to spend eight hours beside you again. 

I love you. 
Always. 
Regardless.

Sometimes I think you forget that. 
You show up, 
do what needs to be done, 
push through tiredness, 
and continue with your day anyway.

When I eventually woke you up, 
I could tell you were still sleepy. 

Your voice was softer, 
your responses were slower, 
and you still sounded like you were halfway between dreaming and being awake.

so I tried my best to be gentle with you.

and let you wake up at your own pace because the last thing I wanted was to annoy my sleepy baby. 

Honestly, 
there is something so cute about you when you are tired. 

You become softer. 

Slower. 

Sleepier. 

And all I want to do in those moments is take care of you. 

I know how annoying it is when you are exhausted and somebody keeps being loud around you, 
forcing you to be awake when all you want is five more minutes of sleep.

talking to you gently and letting you rest as much as you needed. 

At some point, 
I thought we would probably watch a movie together. 

That was the original plan. 

But somehow, 
like always, 
we got distracted. 

Instead of watching anything, 
we ended up talking. 

And talking. 

And talking some more. 

Before either of us realized it, 
six whole hours had already passed. 

And the funny thing is, 
I genuinely cannot remember everything we talked about. 

Usually I can point to specific moments or topics, 
but today feels different. 
It feels like one of those conversations that just flowed naturally from one thing to another. 
We would finish talking about one subject, 
somehow end up somewhere completely different, 
then somehow circle back again. 

All I really remember is how happy I felt the entire time. 

I remember laughing. 

I remember smiling at my screen like an idiot. 

I remember enjoying your company. 

I remember feeling comfortable. 

And I think that says more than the actual topics ever could. 

Because sometimes it is not about what we are talking about. 

It is about who we are talking to. 

And talking to you has always been one of my favorite things. 

There was a little misunderstanding somewhere in the middle of the day too. 
One of those moments where things could have easily gone in a heavier direction if we had let them. 
But what made me happy was how we handled it (me mostly tnx). 

Softly. 

There was no need for walls. 

No need for sharp words. 

No need to make each other feel alone. 

Instead, 
we slowed down. 

We listened. 

We (?) reassured each other.

Actually,

Not that we never misunderstand each other, 
because every couple does. 

But that we keep trying. 

That we keep choosing gentleness. 

That even when something feels uncomfortable, 
we still try to make each other feel safe.

Heard by me. 

Comfortable with me.

By the end of the night, 
the call eventually ended, 
and suddenly the house felt a little quieter again.

six hours,

Because somehow I still ended the night missing you. 

Missing your voice. 

Missing your laugh. 

Missing our conversations. 

Missing the feeling of spending my day with you. 

Maybe that is just what happens when you love someone this much. 

No matter how much time you get with them, 
you always end up wanting a little more. 

Today was simple. 

A tired girlfriend. 

A sleepy voice. 

Six hours of talking. 

A small misunderstanding handled with care. 

And somehow, 
all of that turned into one of my favorite days. 

I am so proud of you for getting through your practicum today baby. 

Get all the rest you need. 

And if today leaves you just as tired,

talking softly to you and reminding you to take care of yourself. 

I miss you already. 

And I love you so much. 
Always. 
Regardless.
156:
Today was a long one, and I loved it.

Of course, because it was us watching it, we did not just sit there quietly. We kept making comments, reacting to scenes, giving our opinions, and occasionally pausing just to talk about what was happening. That's one of my favorite parts of watching movies with you. Then we watched the second movie, which somehow managed to be a romance, a horror movie, and a comedy all at the same time. Watahel. 

I didn't really like that one nearly as much as the first. You already know why. The gore. Eeew. 

So while it was not exactly my favorite movie, I still had fun watching it with you. 

And honestly, that is what I keep coming back to. 

Not necessarily the movies themselves. 

You. 

Because while we were watching today, I kept thinking about how excited I am for the day we get to do this in person. 

Not through a screen. 

Not through a call. 

Actually together. 

I keep imagining us sitting on the same couch, probably with snacks everywhere, watching movies and reacting to them in real time. I can already picture us pausing every five minutes because one of us has something to say. I can picture us looking at each other after a scene and immediately knowing we have completely different opinions. 

I can imagine us finishing a movie and then spending the next hour talking about it instead of starting another one. 

Recalling the funniest scenes. 

Talking about the saddest moments. 

Debating which character was right and which one was completely wrong. 

Making fun of plot holes. 

Quoting our favorite lines. 

Giving overly serious reviews as if anyone asked for them. 

I think that is what I am looking forward to most. 

Not even the movies themselves. 

Just sharing those moments with you. 

Because if there is one thing I've learned, it's that almost everything becomes more enjoyable when I get to experience it with you. 

A good movie becomes better. 

A bad movie becomes funny. 

Even the boring parts become memorable because we're there together. 

Today reminded me of that. 

It reminded me how much I enjoy spending time with you, even when all we are doing is sitting there watching fictional people make questionable decisions for two hours. 

And it also reminded me how much I miss you. 

Because every movie date we have now feels like a small preview of what I want someday. 

A future where I do not have to say goodbye after the credits roll. 

A future where you are right beside me. 

A future where we can spend the entire day watching movies, arguing about characters, laughing at ridiculous scenes, and falling asleep together afterward. 

That sounds pretty perfect to me. 

I had so much fun today, baby. 

I can't wait for the day we finally get to rate movies side by side instead of through a screen. 

I love you, baba. 
Always. 
Regardless.
157:

A safe place. 
A familiar voice. 
Something that makes everything feel less overwhelming. 

So thank you for that, baby.

More people.
More sweating.

nWe ended up talking for a while, and honestly those conversations became the highlight of my day. After everything that happened, after all the travelling, the heat, the exhaustion, and the constant moving around, getting to sit there and talk to you felt like finally coming home for a bit.

Voice got softer.

Something comforting. 

Something that helps you relax enough to let your guard down and rest.

Being the person you call before sleeping. 

Being the voice you want to hear at the end of the day. 

Being someone who helps you rest easier. 

I think that's such a beautiful thing. 

And hearing you slowly fall asleep tonight made me realize just how much I miss you. 
Moments like that make me wish distance did not exist. 

I wish I could just be there. 

I wish I could sit beside you while you get sleepy. 

I wish I could play with your hair while you struggle to keep your eyes open. 

I wish I could kiss your forehead and tell you goodnight properly. 

But for now, I guess I'll settle for calls. 

And honestly, even those mean the world to me. 

I miss you so much, baby. 

I know this trip is only for a week, but I already cannot wait to get back home and spend time with you properly again. 

Until then, please bear with me. 

I love you, baby! 
Always, of course. 
And regardless.
158:

Then another. 

Then another.

Every random conversation, every stop, every little moment, I kept imagining what it would be like if you were there beside me.

It is not even some huge romantic thing. 

It is the simple stuff. 

The everyday stuff. 

The boring stuff. 

The random errands. 

The family trips. 

The unnecessary cafe hopping. 

The moments that seem ordinary.

Already included in everything.
